user_saw: On a busy host, the first Codex turn could fail when model discovery timed out while the app-server was still starting.
summary: The fix gives shared Codex app-server startup its own deadline so discovery can stop waiting while startup continues for subsequent requests.
reasoning: The shared client already closed an initializing server when its last waiter abandoned the acquisition, which was consistent with tying the process lifetime to active claimants. The diff for #168387 moved native discovery from Gateway startup to first use, exposing that policy when a turn needed the same cold startup after discovery had stopped waiting. The September cleanup change retained the existing cancellation behavior and added a wait for cleanup.
